turns.match: compare mean median and mode of daily visitors, with a tab for each
turns.script:
scene layout=figure
table m1 | Visitors by day
row m1 | | A Day | B Visitors
row m1 | 2 | Mon | 12
row m1 | 3 | Tue | 30
row m1 | 4 | Wed | 18
row m1 | 5 | Thu | 12
row m1 | 6 | Fri | 8
color hot=#c0392b
say fx strong face=mono | =AVERAGE(B2:B6)
say res | Add all five and divide by five: 80 / 5 = *16*.
pick f tabs | MEAN | MEDIAN | MODE
bind f=mean | set m1.row2 mark=box
bind f=mean | set m1.row3 mark=box
bind f=mean | set m1.row4 mark=box
bind f=mean | set m1.row5 mark=box
bind f=mean | set m1.row6 mark=box
bind f=mean | correct fx | =AVERAGE(B2:B6)
bind f=mean | correct res | Add all five and divide by five: 80 / 5 = *16*.
bind f=median | set m1.row2 mark=box
bind f=median | set m1.row5 mark=box
bind f=median | correct fx | =MEDIAN(B2:B6)
bind f=median | correct res | Sorted it reads 8, 12, 12, 18, 30, so the middle one is *12*.
bind f=median | set res scale=1.1
bind f=mode | set m1.row2 mark=underline
bind f=mode | set m1.row5 mark=underline
bind f=mode | correct fx | =MODE(B2:B6)
bind f=mode | correct res | The value that turns up most often is 12, twice: *12*.
bind f=mode | set fx ink=hot
say x1 choice | Compare them on skewed data
